consequence.statement: A new opt-in capability (global SOPS Age decryption keys for Kustomization on single-tenant clusters); the evidence describes no breakage or required action for existing setups.

original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds support for global SOPS Age decryption keys for Kustomization on single-tenant clusters, a new feature with no stated operational consequence.

decision.reason: [ev-a94d677cfc9f] is a one-line highlight under "Overview of the new features". It only announces new support for global SOPS Age decryption keys for Kustomization on single-tenant clusters. It says nothing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs migrating, so a failure kind would over-claim. "none" (informational) fits a newly added capability. Confidence is low because the excerpt does not explicitly call the feature opt-in.
